newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse to launch Euromark futures.
newsitem.headline: German bourse to launch Euromark futures.

text.p: The German stock exchange Deutsche Boerse AG said on Tuesday that it is to launch one- and three-month Euromark futures on November 12 1996 and January 14 1997 respectively.
The futures contracts will based on the LIBOR, the London Inter Bank Offered Rate.
Trading in FIBOR futures will stop on December 17 if there is no further open interest in this contract before that date, Deutsche Boerse said.
The new products will allow German stock exchange members to trade the whole German mark yield curve from one month to ten years, the bourse said.
The introduction of the new products is aimed at positioning the German bourse for the start of European currency union, as the introduction of the Euro will mean a unified currency market.
